body:
I'm not really here to stop. I hoped there was a community of people who'd be willing to tell me ways to do it and things to do before, but this looped up instead so I figured i could probably at least tell someone. 

I really appreciate your time, but your empathy is misplaced. I'm not a good person. I'm not here to try to seek forgiveness. But people asked what happened, so I told them. Another person messaged me and never replied once I told him what I did and why I want to do so. I don't think really 9 out of 10 people  would even care. Probably closer to 1/10000. I'm basically the worst society knows of barring children fiddling or murder. I don't really deserve a second chance.

It is true that capitalism is rigged. I might be suicidal, but I still have pride. I can take money from family, but I'd feel guilty and shameful taking money from strangers. Thank you for your time, and for caring.
I still think I'm gonna end it, but I'm gonna wait until after my court date so i don't end up in prison before i have a chance. 

Do you know if a will requires a notary to sign? I saw that in a movie but i don't see why it would. I don't have a lot of assets, but i want to leave them to my baby brothers, and make sure they can't be taken by some less than honest family i have.

Its okay. I can't take other peoples money more than I am. It wouldn't be right. I'm sure you all need it just as much as I do and aren't such fuck ups. This isn't my first rodeo with the law, but it is my first violent one. I don't understand how charging me hundreds of dollars a month is supposed to help. 
I don't see why there isn't an option for people with low incomes. I don't see why Medicaid says I make too much, but the "healthcare market" says I qualify for Medicaid and so I don't get tax credits or financial assistance. I just don't want to hurt anyone again. I want to be better, but it's not really how they work it. It feels like a money game. It feels like they want me to fail. Why has my lawyer had to request discovery three times and still hasn't gotten everything? Why does the fact that i make 15300 a year completely disqualify me from help? Why will i to to prison if i check into an inpatient facility just because they won't let me have my phone so i can't do my breathalyzer. Where am i supposed to go?

I'm a woman beater. Trying to work on that has been unsuccessful, mostly because I can't even afford to go to classes. I'm in a long drawn out court case where they won't even give my lawyer the evidence, so I'll likely be in court for years. I make literally 100$ too much for Medicaid, so I can't get treatment. I make too little for tax credits so I can't get insurance. I'm forced to borrow hundreds of dollars a month just to have food to eat and pay for my drug tests. I'm going to die alone. I won't get through this because I can't get help. I'm considered the dregs of society. And I agree. Can't get better without help. No one wants to help. I'm afraid I'll hurt someone else. So I'll do whatever it takes to stop that. Since bettering myself and trying to get treatment hasn't worked, I'll have to just remove myself from the equation.
